page.overview:
What is Ogerpon?

Ogerpon is a bipedal Pokémon that resembles a forest sprite. It has a round orange face, large yellow eyes with star-pupils, and a round-shaped plump body with covered in (or made of) in leaves and floral clothing (with the appearance of a ). Its face is lined with a dark brown, almost black woody "hood" from which four thorns protrude, as well as a bud-like protrusion on the top of its head. Most of its body is covered by its leaf-like "coat". Its torso and plump belly are made of green leafy moss-like foliage, with a fringe of leaves at the end, and two thin dark brown woody legs and feet that resemble the trunk of a small tree, the insides of which are a lighter shade of brown. Both of its feet are adorned with small bud-like leaves, and it appears to have two toes. On its leafy belly are two yellow dot-like patches, and one star-shaped white mark. It wears various masks to use in battle that alter its typing:

According to the people of Kitakami, the mask it dons is described as fearsome and it referred as the evil ogre that once attacked Kitakami until it was stopped by The Loyal Three, Okidogi, Munkidori and Fezandipiti.

However, as revealed by Yukito, Ogerpon originally traveled with another person before it was bullied by Okidogi, Munkidori, Fezandipiti and their leader, Pecharunt. While it defeated them, the majority of Kitakami's inhabitants believed they had sacrificed their lives to protect them from the ogre and began fearing Ogerpon. Due to their bullying, Ogerpon has poor relationships with the four, particularly Pecharunt. In reality, Ogerpon is very kindhearted and joyful, yet timid with the tendency to becoming lonely.

Despite being timid around humans, Ogerpon does enjoy the Festival of Masks, being the one time where it can mingle with humans without fear.
